metadata.title: How to Find Heirs for a Florida Probate Property
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
A property owner dies. No probate has been opened. You don't even know who the heirs are. Where do you start?

In this Messy Money micro episode, Florida probate attorney Al Nicoletti and I break down how Real Estate investors can start identifying the potential heirs and family members of a deceased property owner.

We discuss death certificates, obituaries, deeds, marriage and divorce records, and other public records that can help you start piecing together the ownership puzzle.

Watch the FULL Florida Probate Masterclass with Al Nicoletti: https://youtu.be/Dutmzc9gb30 

ATTENTION:
The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
